findings.title: E2E test project excluded from solution — Playwright/NUnit tests never run in CI
findings.rule_violated: CI completeness — all test projects must be exercised in the pipeline
findings.remediation: Add <Project Path="tests/ContestJudging.E2ETests/ContestJudging.E2ETests.csproj" /> to the /tests/ folder in ContestJudging.slnx. Consider a separate CI job for E2E tests with Playwright browser installation.

findings.title: No code coverage collected in CI despite coverlet.collector being configured
findings.rule_violated: Test quality — coverage should be measured and tracked
findings.remediation: Add --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" to the dotnet test command and optionally upload results to a coverage service.

findings.title: Six of seven GitHub Actions use floating major-version tags (supply chain risk)
findings.evidence_snippet:
uses: actions/checkout@v6
uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
uses: actions/cache@v5
findings.rule_violated: SLSA Level 2 — actions should be pinned to digest or full semver
findings.remediation: Pin all actions to full semver (e.g., actions/checkout@v6.1.0) or commit SHA. Enable Dependabot for GitHub Actions updates.

findings.title: No SAST or CodeQL scanning — only dependency scanning is present
findings.evidence_snippet:
security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: OSV-Scanner
        uses: google/osv-scanner-action/osv-scanner-action@v2.3.5
findings.rule_violated: OWASP / DevSecOps — SAST should complement dependency vulnerability scanning
findings.remediation: Add a CodeQL analysis job targeting csharp (and optionally javascript for Blazor WASM client). github/codeql-action provides free scanning for public repos.

findings.title: OSV-Scanner uses --allow-no-lockfiles reducing scan accuracy
findings.rule_violated: Tool configuration — lock files provide precise dependency graphs
findings.remediation: Remove --allow-no-lockfiles. If scans fail without lock files, commit packages.lock.json or enable lock file generation in Directory.Packages.props.

findings.title: release/ directory (published Blazor WASM output) is committed to the repository
findings.evidence_snippet:
release/
  ContestJudging.Web.runtimeconfig.json
  dotnet.js
  e_sqlite3.a
  web.config
  wwwroot/
    _framework/
    index.html
    ...
findings.rule_violated: Repository hygiene — build artifacts should not be version-controlled
findings.remediation: Add release/ to .gitignore and run git rm -r --cached release/. The CI deploy job already publishes to this path.

findings.title: No Dependabot configuration for automated dependency updates
findings.rule_violated: Dependency hygiene — automated updates prevent staleness and known vulnerabilities
findings.remediation: Create .github/dependabot.yml with nuget and github-actions ecosystems on a weekly schedule.

findings.title: No CODEOWNERS file for automated PR review assignment
findings.rule_violated: Code review hygiene — CODEOWNERS ensures appropriate reviewers

findings.title: No PR template or issue templates
findings.remediation: Add .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md with a checklist (tests, format, docs) and a bug report issue template.

findings.title: dotnet-tools.json manifest has no tools configured
findings.rule_violated: Reproducibility — local tool pinning ensures consistent CLI tool versions across environments
findings.remediation: No action required currently. If additional CLI tools are introduced (dotnet-coverage, dotnet-outdated, etc.), register them via dotnet tool install --local.

findings.title: Deploy job redundantly rebuilds from source instead of reusing tested artifacts
findings.evidence_snippet:
deploy:
    needs: [quality-and-test, security-scan]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup .NET ...
      - name: Publish Blazor WASM
        run: dotnet publish src/ContestJudging.Web/ContestJudging.Web.csproj ...
findings.rule_violated: CI integrity — deploy should use tested artifacts, not rebuild
findings.remediation: In the quality-and-test job, run dotnet publish and upload the result via actions/upload-artifact. In the deploy job, download that artifact via actions/download-artifact instead of rebuilding.
